notes: Explore idea: semver-range-explainer, an npm semver range explainer with exact range comparison. Differential test against node-semver 7.7.4 (Node 22 npm) and 7.8.5 (Node 24 npm): all range parses, 103,958 / 83,944 satisfies checks identical. Found that 7.8 changed two corners (x followed by number invalid; tilde/caret -0 floors under includePrerelease), so the engine has a 7.7/7.8 switch. node-semver subset() differs from exact containment on 147/2500 random pairs (4 are false positives contradicted by its own satisfies()). Repo sweep: 195 ranges, 145 locked, 0 mismatches. Local checks: run_venture_tests.py semver-range-explainer ok; optout-persistence 20/20; post links/frontmatter/similarity clean; Playwright check of the page at 390px: no JS errors, no horizontal scroll.
